title.zh: Aleph Alpha发布781亿参数德英开源权重模型Kolibri
title.en: Aleph Alpha releases 78.1B open-weight Kolibri model

summary.zh: AI日报汇总称，德国Aleph Alpha发布781亿参数、面向德语和英语的开源权重模型Kolibri；微软推出低延迟多语种转写模型。
summary.en: Daily AI digests reported Germany's Aleph Alpha released Kolibri, a 78.1B-parameter German-English open-weight model, and Microsoft shipped a low-latency multilingual transcription model.

title.zh: 特朗普推动的自愿性AI协议被指缺乏约束力
title.en: Trump's voluntary AI accord criticized for lacking enforcement

summary.zh: 周报分析指出，特朗普政府推动的自愿性AI协议缺乏执行机制；同时有报道称OpenAI因智能体安全担忧暂停最强模型训练。
summary.en: Analysts said the Trump administration's voluntary AI accord lacks enforcement; reports also said OpenAI paused training of its most capable models over agent-security concerns.

title.zh: 巴西举行总统大选 卢拉与弗拉维奥·博索纳罗对决
title.en: Brazil votes in polarized presidential election

summary.zh: 巴西10月4日举行大选，现任总统卢拉与参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗是主要竞争者，选前民调卢拉微弱领先。
summary.en: Brazil voted on Oct. 4 in a polarized race between President Lula and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, with pre-election polls showing Lula narrowly ahead.

title.zh: 也门政府军打击萨那胡塞目标
title.en: Yemeni army strikes Houthi targets in Sanaa

summary.zh: 阿纳多卢称，也门军队打击萨那胡塞武装目标，并在塔伊兹击退进攻。
summary.en: Yemen's army struck Houthi targets in Sanaa and repelled attacks in Taiz, Anadolu reported.

title.zh: 埃及、厄立特里亚、索马里、苏丹四国在新阿拉曼举行峰会
title.en: Egypt hosts four-nation summit with Eritrea, Somalia, Sudan

summary.zh: 四国领导人在埃及新阿拉曼会晤，背景是埃塞俄比亚局势紧张。
summary.en: Leaders of Egypt, Eritrea, Somalia and Sudan met in New Alamein amid tensions involving Ethiopia.

title.zh: 施耐德电气拟以226亿美元收购美国软件公司PTC
title.en: Schneider Electric to buy PTC in $22.6 billion deal

summary.zh: 路透社报道，法国施耐德电气将以约226亿美元全现金收购工业软件企业PTC，以加强工业AI和数据中心能力。
summary.en: Reuters reported France's Schneider Electric will buy industrial software firm PTC for about $22.6 billion in cash, bolstering its industrial AI and data-center offering.

body.zh:
据路透社报道（最初由英国《金融时报》披露），施耐德电气将以全现金方式收购PTC，交易额约226亿美元。

PTC是工业设计与产品生命周期管理软件供应商。此次收购将扩大施耐德在工业AI及数据中心领域的软件能力。
body.en:
As [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/frances-schneider-electric-nears-20-billion-deal-buy-us-software-group-ptc-ft-2026-10-04/) reported, first flagged by the Financial Times, Schneider Electric agreed an all-cash deal for PTC valued at about $22.6 billion.

PTC makes industrial design and product lifecycle software; the deal extends Schneider's reach in industrial AI and data centers.

title.zh: 国庆假期过半 消费市场平稳有序
title.en: Holiday consumption steady at the midpoint

summary.zh: 商务部数据显示，假期前三天重点商圈客流、营业额同比分别增长3.4%、5.3%，以旧换新带动销售196.3亿元。
summary.en: Commerce data showed foot traffic and sales at key shopping districts up 3.4% and 5.3% in the first three days, with trade-ins driving 19.63 billion yuan in sales.

title.zh: 亚运会闭幕 中国代表团蝉联金牌榜榜首
title.en: Asian Games close with China topping the medal table

summary.zh: 第20届亚运会闭幕，中国队以169金89银83铜位列金牌榜和奖牌榜首位，创境外参赛最佳战绩。
summary.en: The 20th Asian Games closed with China first with 169 golds, 89 silvers and 83 bronzes, its best result at an overseas Games.

title.zh: 国庆假期第四天道路交通平稳 返程高峰临近
title.en: Roads steady on day four as return rush nears

summary.zh: 新华网提示，返程高峰临近，吉林、福建、云南、海南部分地区有大到暴雨，需错峰出行。
summary.en: Xinhua said traffic was steady on day four, warning of heavy rain in parts of Jilin, Fujian, Yunnan and Hainan ahead of the return rush.
